title: Every roadmap writer is held to the note cap at commit, not only triage
why: Finding, Oct 27 (triage 8): other threads pushed notes over 250 words five times in one hour, and each blocked triage's next commit until triage trimmed someone else's note.
note: Today only triage gates its commits on build.py's upkeep line; other threads append to notes and push. Next cloud lane: a pre-commit hook on the roadmap branch (installed by a one-line setup the branch CLAUDE.md names) runs build.py and refuses a commit that leaves a note over 250 words, naming the note; red first on today's c122 append. Needs no answer. Port: no; the roadmap branch is claude-settings' own. Placed ahead of c107 (triage, Oct 27): it costs triage a trim on nearly every write.
